story_info.title: Barnaby Bunny and the Winking Stars
story_info.subtitle: A cozy story about finding calm under the night sky.
story_info.moral: Finding peace and comfort through imagination.

main_character.name: Barnaby Bunny
main_character.appearance: Barnaby is a small, soft grey-and-white bunny with long floppy ears, round sleepy eyes, and a little pink nose. He has a plush, huggable, storybook-soft look.

cover.prompt: A Pixar-quality 3D illustration of Barnaby Bunny, a small, soft grey-and-white bunny with long floppy ears, round sleepy eyes, and a little pink nose, looking up at the night sky in Moonlight Meadow. Stars are starting to appear. He looks calm and gentle. Soft lighting, pastel colours, children's book illustration, vertical composition, Instagram friendly.
cover.visual_action: Barnaby Bunny looks up at the first stars

slides.title: The First Star
slides.text: Barnaby Bunny sat in his favourite Moonlight Meadow. The sun was going down low. The sky turned soft shades of pink and purple. Soon, night would come. Barnaby felt a gentle sleepy feeling. He looked up to the big sky. A tiny, bright star winked. It was the very first star of the evening.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby Bunny is in his special meadow, watching the sunset and the first star appear.

slides.title: Shiny Diamonds
slides.text: More and more stars started to pop out. They looked like tiny, shiny diamonds across the dark blue blanket. Barnaby loved watching them sparkle. 'Hello, stars!' he whispered with a smile. He wished he could touch a star. He wished he could hold its gentle light in his paw.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby Bunny sees many stars and wishes he could touch them.

slides.title: Too Far Away
slides.text: Barnaby stood on his tiptoes. He stretched his soft, grey-and-white paws way up high. 'Are you closer now?' he asked the twinkling sky. But the stars stayed very, very far away. They just twinkled from up above. Barnaby felt a tiny bit sad. He could not reach them.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby Bunny tries to reach the stars but finds they are too high, making him a little sad.

slides.title: A Gentle Idea
slides.text: Then Barnaby had a warm, gentle idea. He found his most favourite fluffy cloud spot. It was very soft, just like a cozy bed. He lay down flat on his back. He closed his round sleepy eyes for a short moment. He took a slow, calm, deep breath in and out.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby Bunny finds his cozy spot and begins to relax with deep breaths.

slides.title: Sweet Dreams
slides.text: Barnaby opened his sleepy eyes again. The stars looked like little lamps hanging above him. They were shining just for Barnaby. He felt so warm and comfortable. He imagined the stars were singing him a soft lullaby. He smiled a sweet, happy smile. Sweet dreams begin with a smile!
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby Bunny feels calm and happy under the stars, ready for sweet dreams.

instagram.caption: Does your little one wish upon a star before bed? Tonight, join our gentle friend Barnaby Bunny in his favourite Moonlight Meadow. As the sun sets and the first stars begin to wink, Barnaby feels sleepy but also wants to reach the faraway lights. He finds a special way to feel close to them, right from his cozy spot. This heartwarming tale teaches little ones how to relax their minds and embrace imagination for a peaceful night's sleep. Perfect for a calming Sunday evening routine with your child. Save this story for your next reading time.
